description: Source code for streaming object database (ODB) handling in Git, including filtered and in-core read streams, and functions for opening streams and reading objects.

classes.name: odb_filtered_read_stream
classes.description: Stream structure for filtered reading with buffering and filtering.

classes.name: odb_incore_read_stream
classes.description: In-core stream structure for reading object data directly from memory.

methods.name: close_istream_filtered
methods.description: Closes filtered stream, frees filter, and closes upstream stream.

methods.name: read_istream_filtered
methods.description: Reads filtered data from the stream, applying stream_filter.

methods.name: attach_stream_filter
methods.description: Attaches a stream filter to an existing stream, returning a new filtered stream.

methods.name: close_istream_incore
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for in-core buffer.

methods.name: open_istream_incore
methods.description: Opens an in-core stream for a given object ID, reading object info.

methods.name: istream_source
methods.description: Attempts to get object stream from packfile, alternates, or in-core.
